messages:
alice: Heads up — APAC GPU warm pool fine but new nodes failing onboarding, getting 403 on audit S3 puts. Spotted at 23:12 UTC. :warning:
ben: Any IAM changes recently?
deploy-bot: PolicyUpdate: iam-policy/redwood-audit-writer updated by infra-ci at 23:09 UTC
carla: Yep. New conditional deny requires instances to have subnet tag 'audit-allowed' for s3:PutObject. New instances in private subnets aren't tagged yet, so bootstrap fails after KMS handshake.
dana: That prevents keystore enrollment and the agents can't finish. We're losing ~10-15% capacity in APAC scheduler.
ben: Short fixes: revert change, add temporary exception for gpu-onboard role, or stand up an audit-proxy endpoint that writes to S3 on behalf of instances.
carla: Revert is easy but undermines the hardening. Prefer short-lived exception + proxy.
dana: Proxy via PrivateLink looks best: only allow privatelink endpoint and a small proxy ASG. Lower blast radius, keeps deny in place.
alice: Can we timebox an IAM exception limited to path prefix and TTL 4h for onboarding role?
ben: Draft IAM snippet I can push to infra-cfg (will include in PR):
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "s3:PutObject",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-audit-bucket/onboard/*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalTag/Role": "gpu-onboard"},
    "Bool": {"redwood:Onboarding": "true"}
  }
}
```
carla: Add CloudTrail filters to flag any PutObject outside the proxy path and an alert on unusual prefixes.
dana: I'll spin up canary proxy ASG in APAC internal subnets and a privatelink endpoint. Deploying now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: stack/gpu-audit-proxy/canary by dana at 23:36 UTC
dana: Canary up, running onboarding test: node triggered bootstrap, audit-agent logs show successful Put via proxy, latency ~40ms. Warmup unchanged.
ben: Cost check — proxy steady cost ~ $700/mo plus negligible intra-region data. Cross-region fallback (send to EU) would be ~ $1200/mo egress for 10GB/day — not acceptable.
alice: OK pragmatically: proxy + short-lived IAM exception. Platform to own proxy, infra keeps IAM rules.
carla: I'll open the PR for the IAM exception with TTL and add the test that validates onboarding writes under the condition. Also add runbook steps and a postmortem template entry.
dana: I'll post ASG config and runbook in #runbooks and tune autoscaling for burst onboarding.
ben: Added alert: "Audit writes failing - 403" -> page infra if >5 nodes failing in 5m.
sre-rotation-bot: Pager schedule: on-call/infra -> @ben on-call for next 6 hours
alice: Thanks — 15-min sync in 30 to decide if we keep exception or promote proxy as long-term. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
